analysis.purpose: Version-control helpers for incremental indexing: typed wrappers over git that report which files changed since an anchor commit, degrading rather than failing when there is no git.
responsibilities: Report changed files since an anchor commit, repo-relative
Resolve the current head for the manifest
Degrade gracefully when the repo is not a git checkout

businessRules.rule: A non-git repo or a missing anchor is reported, never thrown, so the caller falls back to a full index.
businessRules.rationale: Incremental update is an optimisation; losing it must not break indexing.

edges.rationale: This file wraps git for the pipeline.
